name: nerf-watch
description: Find out when your coding agent quietly got worse or more expensive. Reads local Claude Code and Codex session logs and flags changes you did not make.

interface.longDescription: nerf-watch reads the session logs Codex and Claude Code already keep on this machine and reports changes you did not make: a different model answering than the one you picked, lower reasoning effort, a smaller context window, more cache writes or uncached input per turn after a CLI update, a cache hit rate collapse, or more failing tool calls. Each finding shows before and after numbers, CLI versions, dates and sample sizes. The plugin adds a skill that runs the nerf-watch CLI through npx and explains the findings. It works locally and never uploads anything; nerf-watch share only prints an anonymized summary and a prefilled issue link for you to submit yourself. Requires Node 20+.
capabilities: Reads local Codex and Claude Code session logs
Flags model, effort, context window, cache and cost changes you did not make
Writes an anonymized report for a bug report
defaultPrompt: Did my coding agent get worse or more expensive lately?
Check whether the last Codex update changed cache or token use
Write an anonymized nerf-watch report for a bug report
